hook: This verse about *Ramadan nights* is about your *future child.*
next: Next: the du'a the Prophets made for children

scenes.text: There's a verse about the nights of Ramadan that's actually about your future child.

arabic.text: فَٱلْـَٰٔنَ بَٰشِرُوهُنَّ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ

scenes.text: Allah says: / so now, be with your wives / and *seek* what Allah has *written for you.*
And Ibn al-Qayyim explains *why* it's there.
In that moment / a person thinks of _nothing else._
Don't come to it for _desire alone._ / Want *the reward.*

arabic.text: يعبد الله لا يشرك به شيئا

scenes.text: Want a child / who will *worship Allah* / and no one beside Him.
